title: Non-terminal SSE stream disconnect leaves turn permanently stuck in Working state
description: In sse.ts and EnabledWorkspace.tsx, if an SSE connection is dropped by the network or CloudFront before a terminal event arrives, the client only records streamError without attempting reconnect or reconciling the turn, leaving the UI permanently hanging in Working/Responding state.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
Triage 2026-09-14 (Chatticus): CONFIRMED in code (SSE kill not forced live).

`web/lib/sse.ts`: mid-stream error calls `onError` then `onClose`. `EnabledWorkspace` only `setStreamError(...)` — it does not set `turnStatus` to failed, clear `turn`, or stop showing “Working…”. Abort without a terminal event leaves `turnStatus === "active"` and `turn` non-null.

Fix: on stream error/unexpected close without terminal event, mark reconciling or failed, clear or park the active turn UI, and optionally attempt one resume via Last-Event-ID.
